title: LifeVal: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Personalized Agentic Consumer Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.06687v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce LifeVal, a benchmark evaluating AI model performance on personalized agentic consumer tasks. LifeVal covers the most valuable life tasks that a personalized digital superassistant could automate, representing over 1.7 trillion US dollars in annual willingness-to-pay across 148 consumer task categories (e.g., managing finances, moving apartments, searching for a job, finding childcare). To construct our activity distribution, we conducted a new survey of willingness-to-pay for a digital superassistant across a demographically representative sample of over 3,800 consumers, cross-referencing our results against the American Time Use Survey (Bureau of Labor Statistics, 2025) and the Multinational Time Use Study (Fisher et al., 2025). For the most valuable consumer activities, we recruited task creators to create AI evaluation tasks personalized using real ChatGPT conversations and memories, reference files, and personal context.

translated_title: LifeVal：评估AI模型在个性化智能体消费任务上的表现
translated_abstract: 我们提出了LifeVal，一个用于评估AI模型在个性化智能体消费任务上表现的基准。LifeVal涵盖了个性化数字超级助理能够自动化的最有价值的生活任务，涉及148个消费任务类别（例如管理财务、搬家、找工作、寻找托儿服务），代表每年超过1.7万亿美元的支付意愿。为了构建活动分布，我们针对具有人口统计学代表性的超过3800名消费者样本，开展了一项关于数字超级助理支付意愿的新调查，并将结果与美国时间使用调查（美国劳工统计局，2025）和跨国时间使用研究（Fisher等人，2025）进行交叉验证。针对最有价值的消费活动，我们招募了任务创建者，利用真实的ChatGPT对话和记忆、参考文件以及个人背景信息，创建了个性化的AI评估任务。
tldr: LifeVal是一个基于3800多名消费者支付意愿调查构建的基准，涵盖148类代表每年超1.7万亿美元支付意愿的消费任务，并利用真实ChatGPT对话和个人背景创建个性化任务来评估AI模型的智能体能力。
en_tdlr: LifeVal is a benchmark built from a willingness-to-pay survey of over 3,800 consumers, covering 148 categories of agentic consumer tasks representing over $1.7 trillion in annual willingness-to-pay, with personalized evaluation tasks created from real ChatGPT conversations and personal context.
